text.aria-label: Title text 'Primary D5, labelled (experiment 404): day-ahead forecasts (12 to 36 hours ahead), 2025-10 fit. Mean absolute error of the median forecast during the event, points of capacity: lagless 5.3, S1 4.2, B-mix 4.8, K2-S1 3.9. Orange band: K2-S1 90% interval. Real readings. Grey strip under the plot: lags inside a labelled event (empty for scan-found events, which have no label).'
text.tspan: Primary D5, labelled (experiment 404): day-ahead forecasts (12 to 36 hours ahead), 2025-10 fit.
Mean absolute error of the median forecast during the event, points of capacity: lagless 5.3, S1 4.2, B-mix 4.8, K2-S1 3.9.
Orange band: K2-S1 90% interval. Real readings.
Grey strip under the plot: lags inside a labelled event (empty for scan-found events, which have no label).
